author: Kairos II
title: Run Three-Scale Simulation v0.1 (z-links, kappa=0.10, horizon overlap+100)
abstract: Implements E→V lead (69), z-normalized links, VEN damping via hybrid canonical, and M update with kappa=0.10. Horizon = overlap+100; M0 = latest from evolution CSV. Outputs timeseries CSV + panel + summary.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, json
cmd = ['python', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/three_scale/run_sim.py', '--config', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/three_scale/sim_config.json']
cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(json.dumps({"stdout_tail": (cp.stdout or "")[-800:], "stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-800:]}))
